source.title: Louisiana State Civil Service - Job Aid 'Understanding State Holidays' (La. R.S. 1:55) with General Circulars 2025-051, 2025-053, 2026-010, 2026-023 and Governor's proclamations 71 and 74 JML 2025, 06 and 07 JML 2026

weekendRule: No fixed statutory shift: the Governor usually designates an alternate day by proclamation (typically Sat->Fri, Sun->Mon); agency heads designate the closest workday for employees whose regular day off is the holiday

stateHolidays.name: Mardi Gras
stateHolidays.note: Statutory legal holiday (R.S. 1:55(B)(1)); Tue Feb 17, 2026; Tue Feb 9, 2027.

stateHolidays.name: Good Friday
stateHolidays.note: Statutory legal holiday (R.S. 1:55(B)(1)); Fri Apr 3, 2026; Fri Mar 26, 2027.

stateHolidays.name: Acadian Day (Friday after Thanksgiving)
stateHolidays.note: Proclaimed by the Governor under R.S. 1:55(B)(3); Civil Service says it is usually proclaimed (confirmed for Nov 29, 2024 and Nov 28, 2025). 2026 and 2027 proclamations not yet issued.

partialOrLocal.name: Extra Christmas day(s) proclaimed by the Governor
partialOrLocal.note: Full paid legal holidays by proclamation (66 JML 2024; 71 JML 2025). Discretionary; no 2026 or 2027 proclamation found yet.

partialOrLocal.name: Extra New Year's day(s) proclaimed by the Governor
partialOrLocal.note: Full paid legal holidays by proclamation (67 JML 2024; 74 JML 2025). Discretionary; none found for the next season yet.

partialOrLocal.name: Lundi Gras 2026
partialOrLocal.note: Proclaimed holiday 02 JML 2026 (GC 2026-010). In 2026 it fell on the same date as Presidents' Day. For 2027 it would be Mon Feb 8.

partialOrLocal.name: Inauguration Day
partialOrLocal.note: Statutory holiday 'once in every four years in the city of Baton Rouge' (R.S. 1:55(B)(1)(a)); next one January 2028.
